shortBio: I design and build robust, scalable web applications — from database architecture to polished user interfaces. Currently leading backend-focused development at Luminate Web Solutions.
fullBio: I'm Mohammed Khaled, a Full Stack Developer based in Hyderabad, India, with a strong focus on backend architecture and scalable systems.

With hands-on experience in building enterprise-grade applications — from ERP systems to institute management platforms — I bring a deep understanding of system design, RESTful APIs, and database architecture.

I lead cross-functional teams, drive technical decisions, and mentor aspiring developers. My approach combines clean code, scalable architecture, and user-centric design to deliver impactful solutions.
Currently at Luminate Web Solutions, I oversee the complete technical lifecycle of multiple projects simultaneously, from requirement analysis through deployment and maintenance.
